Alex H: Quick sync — Hypersys wants to run a joint perf/W sweep next week. Need alignment on workloads, telemetry schema, and publication windows.
Priya G: Thanks. Hypersys = Marco, right?
Marco (Hypersys): yep. Proposed scope: sustained throughput runs (max tokens/sec), perf/W curves at 32k and 64k seq, kernel patches A/B, and a short failure-injection pass.
Alex H: OK. Two asks from our side: (1) shared S3 path for raw telemetry + sha256 manifests, (2) controlled release embargo for 72h after we finish analysis.
Priya G: Can we reuse `redwood-partners/hypersys/2026-03-bench/` as the prefix?
Marco (Hypersys): works for us. We'll push JSON manifests named like `manifest-<run>.json` and a `checksums.txt`.
Lisa: Telemetry schema suggestion — keep it minimal: timestamp, node_id, power_W, token_throughput, kernel_version, env_vars, and an optional `notes` field.
Alex H: I'll drop a sample manifest snippet here: ```json
{"run":"hz-1","seq_len":64000,"mode":"sustained","nodes":["r1","r2"],"schema_version":"v1"}
```
Priya G: Also define sampling rates: propose 1s samples for power, 100ms counters for throughput (we'll aggregate). Is 100ms too heavy for storage?
Marco (Hypersys): 1s power is fine. Throughput: we can emit raw counters every 100ms but store aggregated 200ms averages to the bucket to keep size sane.
Alex H: Kernel patch plan — baseline = `v2.1`, tuned = `v2.1+patchX`. We should record kernel_version in every sample. Lisa, can you own the baseline config?
Lisa: Yep — I'll create a small repo under github.com/redwood-inference/bench-schemas with the schema + a config example.
Alex H: NDAs/publication — Hypersys wants a co-branded blog. Legal signoff required. Proposal: embargo results until both legal teams approve, target announce 2026-04-07.
Priya G: I'll loop in legal (cc @mike-legal).
OpsBot: Reminder: bench resources booked on 2026-03-26 09:00 UTC -> 12:00 UTC :calendar:
Marco (Hypersys): we'll also provide a tiny smoke script for validation: `bench-run --profile power --mode sustained --duration 1800`
Lisa: Can someone add the kernel patch baseline to the manifest (fields: baseline_version, tuned_version, patch_notes_url)?
Marco (Hypersys): will do. We'll ship patches via our private repo and invite `hypersys-bench` as collaborator to the S3 prefix.
Alex H: Next steps summary: Priya loop legal, Lisa publish schema gist + repo stub, Marco upload initial manifest & checksums by EOD Friday, Ops confirm bench booking and credentials. :thumbsup:
Priya G: on it.
Marco (Hypersys): uploading initial manifest now, will ping when done.
Alex H: thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after first telemetry lands.
